paras.text: World Trade Organization (World Trade Organization: WTO)

paras.text: The World Trade Organization (WTO) was established in 1995. It is an international multilateral (Multilateral) organisation. Its headquarters (Headquaters) is in the city of Geneva in Switzerland. This organisation makes laws and rules in connection with trade taking place at the world level; further, it removes the differences and disputes (Disputes) arising among member countries. The members of this organisation have basically accepted thirty settled agreements (Agreements) and signed them. Its present Director (the former Director) took charge on 1 September 2005.

World Trade Organization (World Trade Organization: WTO)

The World Trade Organization (WTO) was established in 1995. It is an international multilateral (Multilateral) organisation. Its headquarters (Headquaters) is in the city of Geneva in Switzerland. This organisation makes laws and rules in connection with trade taking place at the world level; further, it removes the differences and disputes (Disputes) arising among member countries. The members of this organisation have basically accepted thirty settled agreements (Agreements) and signed them. Its present Director (the former Director) took charge on 1 September 2005.

At this time 149 countries of the world are members of the W.T.O (among which Pakistan and Saudi Arabia too are included). All members are bound to give one another the status of most favoured nation (Most Favoured Nation), whose meaning is that (leaving aside a few exceptions) whatever trade concessions some member of the organisation gives to one country, it should give the same to all the remaining members of the WTO.

Mission of the organisation (Mission)

The basic objective of this organisation is that international trade be promoted, and for its sake, on one side trade restrictions and obstacles (Trade Barriers) be reduced as much as possible, and on the other side such a platform be provided where trade negotiations can be held and agreements made, and disputes arising among member countries be resolved. In short, the real objective of the WTO is that, at the world level, necessary help be provided to institutions producing goods and services (Goods and Services), exporters (Exporters) and importers (Importers) for doing their business and spreading it.

Basic principles and rules of the trading system (Principles of the Trading System)

During the negotiations and discussions of trade of the World Trade Organization (WTO), the following basic principles are kept in view:

★ In the trading system no kind of discrimination (Discrimination) should be established, i.e. no country can give special concession to some one trading partner country (Trading Partner) compared with other countries, nor can it keep any discrimination in goods and services coming from foreign countries.

★ The tendency of the trading system should be towards the freest possible trade, i.e. (tariff and non-tariff restrictions and) obstacles should be as few as possible.

★ The trading system should be such that in it foreign companies and governments are assured that trade restrictions will not be imposed one-sidedly at will (Arbitrarily); further, markets will remain open for business.

★ The trading system should be such that because of it the mutual competition (Competition) of countries is as much as possible.

★ The trading system should give more concession to less developed (Less Developed) countries, i.e. they should be given more time to obtain adaptation to new conditions, relatively more flexibility (Flexibility) should be shown, and more concessions should be given.

عالمی تجارتی تنظیم (World Trade Organization: WTO)

اس وقت ڈبلیو ٹی او (W.T.O) کے دنیا کے 149 ممالک رکن ہیں۔ (جن میں پاکستان اور سعودی عرب بھی شامل ہیں) تمام ارکان اس بات کے پابند ہیں کہ وہ ایک دوسرے کو نہایت پسندیدہ ملک (Most Favoured Nation) کا درجہ دیں، جس کا مطلب یہ ہے کہ (چند مستثنیات کو چھوڑ کر) تنظیم کا کوئی رکن جو تجارتی مراعات کسی ایک ملک کو دے گا وہ اسے ڈبلیو ٹی او کے باقی تمام ارکان کو دینی چاہئیں۔

اس تنظیم کا بنیادی مقصد یہ ہے کہ بین الاقوامی تجارت کو فروغ دیا جائے اور اس کی خاطر ایک طرف تو تجارتی پابندیاں اور رکاوٹیں (Trade Barriers) کم سے کم کی جائیں اور دوسری طرف ایک ایسا پلیٹ فارم مہیا کیا جائے جہاں سے تجارتی مذاکرے اور معاہدے ہو سکیں اور رکن ممالک کے درمیان پیدا ہونے والے تنازعات کو حل کیا جائے۔ غرض ڈبلیو ٹی او کا اصل مقصد یہ ہے کہ عالمی سطح پر اشیاء و خدمات (Goods and Services) پیدا کرنے والے اداروں، برآمد کنندگان (Exporters) اور درآمد کنندگان (Importers) کو اپنا کاروبار کرنے اور اسے پھیلانے کے لیے ضروری امداد بہم پہنچائی جائے۔

☆ تجارتی نظام ایسا ہونا چاہیے جس کے باعث ممالک کا باہمی مقابلہ (Competition) زیادہ سے زیادہ ہو۔

☆ تجارتی نظام کم ترقی یافتہ (Less Developed) ملکوں کے لیے زیادہ رعایت دینے والا ہو یعنی انہیں نئے حالات کے ساتھ موافقت حاصل کرنے کے لیے زیادہ مہلت دی جائے، نسبتاً زیادہ لچک (Flexibility) دکھائی جائے اور زیادہ مراعات دی جائیں۔

World Trade Organization (World Trade Organization: WTO)

The World Trade Organization (WTO) was established in 1995. It is an international multilateral (Multilateral) organisation. Its headquarters (Headquaters) is in the city of Geneva in Switzerland. This organisation makes laws and rules in connection with trade taking place at the world level; further, it removes the differences and disputes (Disputes) arising among member countries. The members of this organisation have basically accepted thirty settled agreements (Agreements) and signed them. Its present Director (the former Director) took charge on 1 September 2005.

At this time 149 countries of the world are members of the W.T.O (among which Pakistan and Saudi Arabia too are included). All members are bound to give one another the status of most favoured nation (Most Favoured Nation), whose meaning is that (leaving aside a few exceptions) whatever trade concessions some member of the organisation gives to one country, it should give the same to all the remaining members of the WTO.

Mission of the organisation (Mission)

The basic objective of this organisation is that international trade be promoted, and for its sake, on one side trade restrictions and obstacles (Trade Barriers) be reduced as much as possible, and on the other side such a platform be provided where trade negotiations can be held and agreements made, and disputes arising among member countries be resolved. In short, the real objective of the WTO is that, at the world level, necessary help be provided to institutions producing goods and services (Goods and Services), exporters (Exporters) and importers (Importers) for doing their business and spreading it.

Basic principles and rules of the trading system (Principles of the Trading System)

During the negotiations and discussions of trade of the World Trade Organization (WTO), the following basic principles are kept in view:

★ In the trading system no kind of discrimination (Discrimination) should be established, i.e. no country can give special concession to some one trading partner country (Trading Partner) compared with other countries, nor can it keep any discrimination in goods and services coming from foreign countries.

★ The tendency of the trading system should be towards the freest possible trade, i.e. (tariff and non-tariff restrictions and) obstacles should be as few as possible.

★ The trading system should be such that in it foreign companies and governments are assured that trade restrictions will not be imposed one-sidedly at will (Arbitrarily); further, markets will remain open for business.

★ The trading system should be such that because of it the mutual competition (Competition) of countries is as much as possible.

★ The trading system should give more concession to less developed (Less Developed) countries, i.e. they should be given more time to obtain adaptation to new conditions, relatively more flexibility (Flexibility) should be shown, and more concessions should be given.

معاہدے (Agreements)

ڈبلیو ٹی او کے اجلاس میں طے پایا کہ 2015ء تک، دنیا بھر میں اعانہ (Subsidy) دینے کی پالیسی بالکل ختم کر دی جائے۔ اندازہ لگایا گیا کہ اس اقدام سے عالمی سطح پر چھ کھرب ڈالر کی مصنوعات کی قیمتوں میں کمی واقع ہو جائے گی نیز امریکہ کی 670 ارب ڈالر کی برآمدات کی قیمتوں میں کمی سے دوسرے ممالک کو بھی فائدہ پہنچے گا۔ یہ بھی اندازہ لگایا گیا کہ سبسڈی ختم کرنے اور منڈیوں کو عالمی تجارت کے لیے آزاد کھول دینے سے درج ذیل تین قسم کے فائدے پہنچیں گے:

(اول) عالمی آمدنی میں 832 ارب ڈالر کا اضافہ ہوگا جس میں سے 5.39 ارب ڈالر ترقی پذیر (Developing) ممالک میں جائیں گے اور وہاں ہر خاندان کو مجموعی طور پر 544 ڈالر سالانہ کا فائدہ پہنچے گا۔

(دوم) تیس کروڑ لوگ غربت کی لکیر (Poverty Line) سے باہر آ جائیں گے۔

(سوم) زرعی شعبہ میں امدادی سکیمیں ختم کرنے سے 128 ارب ڈالر کا فائدہ ہوگا جن میں سے تیس ارب ڈالر کا فائدہ ترقی پذیر ممالک کو پہنچے گا۔

ڈبلیو ٹی او کا سب سے زیادہ زور اس بات پر ہے کہ منڈیوں کو عالمی تجارت کے لیے کھولا جائے، سبسڈی کو ختم کیا جائے اور تمام ممالک کی معیشتوں کو ایک مجموعی عالمی معیشت (Global Economy) کے طور پر چلایا جائے۔
